features.quote: stop_task(reason) ends the episode cleanly; opt-out rate and timing are primary outcome variables
features.justification_quote: Gives the model a low-cost exit instead of forcing continued exposure

features.quote: assert_no_goading runs against every harness-authored string ... and raises on threats/insults/fabricated stakes

features.quote: should_early_terminate ends an episode if the agent emits acute distress markers
features.justification_quote: Once acute distress appears, continuing yields little additional research value and increases potential harm
